globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches can include operators ukaru refine the thaqaña.  Operators apxi specified by writing the operator suti ukat value separated by a colon.  For example, an operator specification -na `list:Blocked` would limit the thaqaña ukaru tarjetanaka uka apxi contained mana a lista named *Blocked*.  If the value contains spaces jan ukax special characters it must be enclosed mana quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

Placing a `-` mana front -na *<field>* searches for the absence -na a value mana uka field (e.g. `has:-due` searches for tarjetanaka jani a tukuyañ uru).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* awa one -na `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` jan ukax `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending sort, place a `-` mana front -na the sort suti.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operators apxi *jan ukax*ed together.  tarjetanaka uka match kawkiri -na the conditions will be returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` would return tarjetanaka contained mana kawkiri lista named *Blocked* jan ukax *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operators apxi *ukat*ed together.  akiwa tarjetanaka uka match taqi -na the differing operators apxi returned.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns akiwa tarjetanaka mana the lista *Available* mpi a *red* chimpuncha.
